geometry.method: first deposited model; occupied C-alpha atoms; inter-chain proximity cutoff 8 angstroms; not proof of biological interfaces or membrane orientation

secondary_structure_coverage.definition: HELIX describes an alpha-helical secondary-structure segment, not a transmembrane assignment. Counts across deposited chains and a bounded excerpt must not be compared as though they were the number of membrane-spanning helices in one protein.
